mcq.q: What does the Arabic word اِسْمَعْ (ismaʿ) mean?
mcq.explanation: اِسْمَعْ (ismaʿ) means listen.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ل?
mcq.explanation: The letter ل is called laam.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا مِنْ كينيا mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا مِنْ كينيا (anaa min Kiiniya) means: I am from Kenya.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "small"?
mcq.explanation: صَغِيرٌ (Sagiir) means small.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The water is clean."
mcq.explanation: الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ (al-maa'u nadhiif) means: The water is clean.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My sister reads."
mcq.explanation: أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ (ukhtii taqraʾu) means: My sister reads.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أُسْبُوعٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أُسْبُوعٌ is read usbuuʿ and means week.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَطْبَخٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَطْبَخٌ is read matbakh and means kitchen.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word سَمَكٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: سَمَكٌ is read samak and means fish.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word كُوبٌ (kuub) mean?
mcq.explanation: كُوبٌ (kuub) means cup.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَرْحَبًا (marhaban) mean?
mcq.explanation: مَرْحَبًا (marhaban) means hello.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ذ?
mcq.explanation: The letter ذ is called dhaal.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable دُ?
mcq.explanation: دُ is read du.

mcq.q: What does fii l-matbakhi taawila mean?
options: In the kitchen there is a table.
The book is on the table.
mcq.explanation: fii l-matbakhi means in the kitchen and taawila means a table.

mcq.q: What does the ending -ii mean in abii and ummii?
mcq.explanation: The ending -ii means 'my', so abii is 'my father' and ummii is 'my mother'.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي (asmaʿu bi-udhunii) means: I hear with my ear.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable نُ?
mcq.explanation: نُ is read nu.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word صَدِيقٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: صَدِيقٌ is read sadiiq and means friend.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Happy birthday."
mcq.explanation: عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ (ʿiid miilaad saʿiid) means: Happy birthday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "please, go ahead"?
mcq.explanation: تَفَضَّلْ (tafaddal) means please, go ahead.

mcq.q: What is a dictation?
options: You copy from the board only
The teacher says a word and you write it
mcq.explanation: In a dictation you listen and write what you hear.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ mean?
options: In my house there is a kitchen.
mcq.explanation: شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ (shukran li-istimaaʿikum) means: Thank you for listening.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَخِي يَلْعَبُ mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: أَخِي يَلْعَبُ (akhii yalʿabu) means: My brother plays.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "milk"?
mcq.explanation: حَلِيبٌ (haliib) means milk.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "read"?
mcq.explanation: اِقْرَأْ (iqraʾ) means read.

mcq.q: Which body part is used for the action 'aktubu' (I write)?
mcq.explanation: We write with the hand (yad).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ mean?
mcq.explanation: نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ (nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a) means: We look after the environment.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ن?
mcq.explanation: The letter ن is called nuun.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بِيئَةٌ (bii'a) mean?
mcq.explanation: بِيئَةٌ (bii'a) means environment.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "Saturday"?
mcq.explanation: السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) means Saturday.

mcq.q: What does nahnu narqusu mean?
mcq.explanation: nahnu means we and narqusu means we dance.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "open the door"?
mcq.explanation: افْتَحِ الْبَابَ (iftahi l-baab) means open the door.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word شَجَرَةٌ (shajara) mean?
mcq.explanation: شَجَرَةٌ (shajara) means tree.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ mean?
options: I read a book on Sunday.
I visit my grandmother on Friday.
I help my mother on Saturday.
mcq.explanation: أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ (aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad) means: I read a book on Sunday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I am from Kenya."
mcq.explanation: أَنَا مِنْ كينيا (anaa min Kiiniya) means: I am from Kenya.

mcq.q: What does the small word min mean in anaa min Kiiniya?
mcq.explanation: min means 'from', so the sentence says 'I am from Kenya'.

mcq.q: Which letter completes the word _َمٌ to make fam (mouth)?
mcq.explanation: The word fam (فَمٌ) starts with faa, which has one dot above.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "key"?
mcq.explanation: مِفْتَاحٌ (miftaah) means key.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word خِزَانَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: خِزَانَةٌ is read khizaana and means cupboard.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ش?
mcq.explanation: The letter ش is called shiin.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word اُكْتُبْ (uktub) mean?
mcq.explanation: اُكْتُبْ (uktub) means write.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "What is your name? (to a girl)"
mcq.explanation: مَا اسْمُكِ؟ (maa ismuki?) means: What is your name? (to a girl)

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "behind"?
mcq.explanation: خَلْفَ (khalfa) means behind.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "head"?
mcq.explanation: رَأْسٌ (raʾs) means head.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ط?
mcq.explanation: The letter ط is called Taa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word جَدِيدٌ (jadiid) mean?
mcq.explanation: جَدِيدٌ (jadiid) means new.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word حَقِيبَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: حَقِيبَةٌ is read haqiiba and means bag.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word افْتَحِ الْبَابَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: افْتَحِ الْبَابَ is read iftahi l-baab and means open the door.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَارِدٌ (baarid) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَارِدٌ (baarid) means cold.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ mean?
mcq.explanation: جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ (jismii qawiyy) means: My body is strong.

mcq.q: What is a reader's theatre?
options: A group reads a script aloud with expression
mcq.explanation: In a reader's theatre learners read a script aloud, using their voices to act.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا مَطَرٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: هَذَا مَطَرٌ (haadhaa matar) means: This is rain.

mcq.q: What does as-samaku ladhiidh mean?
mcq.explanation: samak is fish and ladhiidh means delicious.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "house"?
mcq.explanation: بَيْتٌ (bayt) means house.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ج?
mcq.explanation: The letter ج is called jiim.

mcq.q: Which of these is true about the Arabic alphabet?
options: It has capital and small letters
It is read from left to right
mcq.explanation: Arabic has one style for each letter and no capitals.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word زَهْرَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: زَهْرَةٌ is read zahra and means flower.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "We dance."
mcq.explanation: نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ (nahnu narqusu) means: We dance.

mcq.q: Which sound is in the name of the day al-khamiis?
mcq.explanation: The letter kh is a throat sound like a soft clearing of the throat.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word دَوْرُكَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: دَوْرُكَ is read dawruka and means your turn.

mcq.q: What does the word min mean in maTaru mina s-samaa'i?
mcq.explanation: min means 'from', so 'the rain is from the sky'.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ادْخُلْ (udkhul) mean?
mcq.explanation: ادْخُلْ (udkhul) means come in.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ mean?
options: My grandfather is old (big in age).
mcq.explanation: أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ (ukhtii jamiila) means: My sister is beautiful.

mcq.q: Which describing word matches the feminine noun taawila (table)?
mcq.explanation: A feminine noun takes the describing word ending in -a.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word طَمَاطِمُ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: طَمَاطِمُ is read tamaatim and means tomatoes.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "This is rain."
mcq.explanation: هَذَا مَطَرٌ (haadhaa matar) means: This is rain.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My body is strong."
mcq.explanation: جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ (jismii qawiyy) means: My body is strong.

mcq.q: Which pair of syllables makes the word ukhtun (sister)?
mcq.explanation: ukh-tun is the word for sister.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word تَحْتَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: تَحْتَ is read taHta and means under.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable نِ?
mcq.explanation: نِ is read ni.

mcq.q: Which day begins the week in the Arabic list?
mcq.explanation: The Arabic week begins with al-ahad, Sunday.

mcq.q: How would a girl say 'I am a pupil'?
mcq.explanation: A girl uses tilmiidha, with the ending -a. A boy says tilmiidh.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence لِي عَيْنَانِ mean?
mcq.explanation: لِي عَيْنَانِ (lii ʿaynaani) means: I have two eyes.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ mean?
options: Above the table there is a balloon.
On the table there is a cake.
The friends are at the party.
mcq.explanation: عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka) means: On the table there is a cake.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable سُ?
mcq.explanation: سُ is read su.

mcq.q: What should you write on the back of a body flashcard?
mcq.explanation: The Arabic word is on the front. The back has the sound and the meaning.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ (anaa uhibbu l-hafla) means: I like the party.

mcq.q: What does the word wa mean in khubzan wa bayDan?
mcq.explanation: wa means 'and', so the phrase is 'bread and eggs'.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ك?
mcq.explanation: The letter ك is called kaaf.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I like my house."
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي (uhibbu baytii) means: I like my house.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "thank you"?
mcq.explanation: شُكْرًا (shukran) means thank you.

mcq.q: What does ʿindii hadiyya mean?
mcq.explanation: ʿindii means I have and hadiyya means gift.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ mean?
options: In my house there is a kitchen.
mcq.explanation: أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ (anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ) means: I am in Grade 4.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I smell with my nose."
mcq.explanation: أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي (ashummu bi-anfii) means: I smell with my nose.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ا?
mcq.explanation: The letter ا is called alif.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Do you like bananas?"
mcq.explanation: هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟ (hal tuhibbu l-mawz?) means: Do you like bananas?

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word جَدٌّ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: جَدٌّ is read jadd and means grandfather.

mcq.q: Which strategy uses a picture or the sentence to guess a word?
mcq.explanation: Cues are clues such as pictures and the words around the new word.

mcq.q: What is word spacing?
mcq.explanation: Word spacing is the neat gap between one word and the next.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word سُكَّرٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: سُكَّرٌ is read sukkar and means sugar.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The table is small."
mcq.explanation: الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ (at-taawilatu Sagiira) means: The table is small.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ayna ask?
mcq.explanation: ayna means 'where'.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word عَصِيرٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: عَصِيرٌ is read ʿasiir and means juice.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ف?
mcq.explanation: The letter ف is called faa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) mean?
mcq.explanation: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) means peace be upon you.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word شَعْرٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: شَعْرٌ is read shaʿr and means hair.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا عِنْدَ الْبَابِ mean?
options: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The lamp is above the table.
mcq.explanation: أَنَا عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (anaa ʿinda l-baab) means: I am at the door.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "tomorrow"?
mcq.explanation: غَدًا (ghadan) means tomorrow.

mcq.q: In the sentence fii s-sabaah aakulu khubzan wa bayDan, which words show that the meal is in the morning?
mcq.explanation: sabaah means morning, so fii s-sabaah is 'in the morning'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "cat"?
mcq.explanation: قِطَّةٌ (qitta) means cat.
